name: Hanshoku Kyoushitsu ~Joshikou Harem Nara Nani o Yatte mo Yurusareru!?~
original_name: 繁触きょうしつ ～女子校ハーレムなら何をヤっても許される!?～
source:
The time is the near future.
Gene splicing has resulted in the birth of a new being.

This living plant has the ability to understand human language
and bears an open, kind and sincere soul.
The only problem is that it looks like a tangled mess of tentacles.

Genetic modification is declared a success, but
unsure how to proceed, the father of this creation decides to hide it in society.
Dubbed "Embryo-kun", the living plant is dispatched to a place where
it may be allowed to survive... such as an all-girl school!

They don't mind! A man is a man, IS A MAN!
So begins Embryo-kun's bizarre love life.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133765.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
时间是不久的将来。
基因剪接导致了新生命的诞生。

这种活植物具有理解人类语言的能力
并拥有开放、善良和真诚的灵魂。
唯一的问题是它看起来像一团乱七八糟的触手。

基因改造宣告成功，但
由于不确定如何继续，这个创作之父决定将其隐藏在社会中。
被称为“胚胎君”的活植物被送往一个地方
它可能会被允许生存……比如一所女子学校！

他们不介意！男人就是男人，就是男人！
胚胎君离奇的爱情生活就这样开始了。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133765.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
